definition.analysis: Exact (Clopper-Pearson) intervals wherever a bootstrap collapsed: Study 1b om@6 pieces; top-up main-om pieces; C10 Opus pieces; item 7 Opus per-piece; length-sweep Opus-medium at 6 and 16 steps and its q; Study 1's 3-try Haiku-max vote on chains; Study 1b's Haiku-max vote@10 on pieces; thinking-off chains at 16 steps.
definition.inputs: the keys named, in the three analysis files, groupc.json and the length-sweep file
definition.why: The approved style sheet requires it; a [100, 100] band suggests false certainty.

label: post hoc (D-131): reported as a result labelled post hoc, never as a test; it cannot change a pre-registered reading

result.method: report_arms.clopper_pearson(x, n), two-sided 95%, over base puzzles (the conservative unit); at the stamped interval's own level (a 90% interval gets a 90% exact interval)
result.q_note: the length sweep's q is estimated from pieces only, so its exact counterpart is the pieces per-step row

revision.why: fa4r2.json read only fields named ci95, so it missed collapsed intervals stored under other names: item 9e's Opus-medium accuracy on the even base puzzles (opus_accuracy_ci95, printed in TAB-08) and the fairness check's misapplied-rule rates (ci90, printed nowhere). Revision 3 (D-144) keeps revision 2's cells unchanged and scans every interval field by name, listing every two-number field it does not treat as an interval

quartiles.why: the first and third quartiles of a spread, not an interval for an estimate
